description: Searches WoW lore, Forever reference data and the game-file catalogs (achievements, factions, titles, quest chains, mounts, legacy perks, races, instances) by names, keywords or a question. Exact-name matches rank first. Every hit carries its id, kind, source, licence and date, and a game-file hit says when player uploads confirm it. Use it to find a record from a name or a topic, then pass the hit's id to get_entity for its summary, or to fetch as a string for the whole text. Use get_by_name when you already know the exact full name, and answer_sources when you need cited evidence for a question rather than records. search is the same search in the ChatGPT connector shape.

kind.description: Narrow to one record kind. achievement, faction, title, quest_chain, mount, legacy_perk, race and instance come from the game files (found in game files, unconfirmed); item, npc, object, quest, zone, spell, lore_page, creator and realm from the knowledge release; build is an Everloot team starter talent build, not observed. Without it, every kind.

query.description: What to look up: names, questions, keywords. Question words are ignored.

version.description: Narrow to one game version: forever, classic, retail or lore. Without it, every version.

name: search_knowledge

confirmed.description: Present when player uploads confirm this game-file entry (3 or more installs agree). asOf is the date the rollup was current.

extId.description: The source's own id, such as a wiki page title.

licence.description: The source's licence, such as CC-BY-SA-4.0.

snippet.description: A short excerpt, in the source's words.

sourceUrl.description: Where the record came from. Keep it with the text.

url.description: The record's page on everloot.app, absolute: an indexed lore page or a catalog page. Absent for a record the site has no page for.

title: Search the Everloot knowledge base
